messages:
elaine: Quick check-in after the P-312 postmortem (kv-cache eviction spikes). Need explicit remediation owners, short timelines, and concrete runbook/playbook additions for triage + escalation. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/p-312 :link:

miguel: I'll take the cache tuning and batching changes. Steps: reproduce in staging, iterate configs, run load test, then a small canary. Aim: staging repro by Mon EOD, config PR Wed, canary Fri.

ashley: I'll own the runbook and playbook edits. I want dry, copy-paste commands and a 3-step checklist for run responders. Do we want an ops-level `kubectl` snippet and a gosu/exec example?

dena: Escalation guidance: if eviction_rate > 8% sustained for 3m -> page SRE. If eviction_rate > 15% or tail latency > 600ms -> page Dedicated capacity lead and oncall. Add fallback to `redwood-small` variant when tail latency exceeds threshold.

oncall-bot: Oncall rotation: SRE oncall = @ashley; paging policy: alert -> 5m ack -> escalate.

miguel: Draft runbook entries for "cache thrash" triage (to paste into playbook):

```
# inspect eviction metric
kubectl exec -it $(kubectl get pods -l app=kv-cache -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- sh -c "curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9090/metrics | grep cache_eviction_rate"

# bump entries and disable immediate eviction
kubectl patch configmap cache-config -p '{"data":{"max_entries":"250000","eviction_policy":"lazy"}}'

# force reload config
kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache
```

ashley: Nice. I'll add a one-paragraph rationale and a short rollback snippet (restore previous config from git tag). PR target: Thu morning. I'll tag @miguel and @dena for review.

dena: Monitoring: create two alert severities on cache_eviction_rate: WARN (2x baseline) -> notify #incidents; SEV (5x baseline) -> page SRE + Dedicated lead. Add automation: if the same SEV fires 3 times within 14 days, auto-create a follow-up ticket and schedule a retro.

frank: I'll coordinate the follow-ups. Plan: weekly 30-minute sync with owners until all actions closed; if recurrence detected, move to Ops retro agenda. I'll send invites today.

elaine: Agreed owners & deadlines:
- miguel: reproduce + tuning (staging Mon EOD; config PR Wed; canary Fri)
- ashley: runbook & playbook edits (PR Thu AM)
- dena: alerts + recurrence rule (PR Wed)
- frank: cadence / follow-up owner (recurring weekly invite today)

Immediate runbook edits to include: exact triage commands (above), rollback steps, clear escalation ladder to Dedicated, alert thresholds, and model-fallback note for `redwood-small`. React with :white_check_mark: to accept. I'll close once PR links are posted.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-4729 follow-up (owners: miguel, ashley, dena).
